intro.title: Introduction
intro.preview: Dear Client, as discussed, we are pleased to submit…
intro.body:
Dear Client,

as discussed, we are pleased to submit this quotation for the supply and installation of Schüco window systems for your project.

We remain at your disposal for any clarification.
